title: Psychobuch 2

description.main: Psychobuch 2 is Beni Bischof's 2026 sequel to his 2014 debut monograph, a 752-page survey of the Swiss artist's drawings, paintings, sculptures, installations, and collages, published by Edition Patrick Frey with over 1,700 color images.
description.extended:
Psychobuch 2 is Beni Bischof's 2026 sequel to his 2014 debut monograph, a 752-page survey of the Swiss artist's drawings, paintings, sculptures, installations, and collages, published by Edition Patrick Frey.

The book gathers more than 1,700 color images. The publisher calls it a comprehensive but deliberately incomplete presentation of Bischof's output, one that also stands as an independent artist's book in its own right. It continues the appropriation-based practice of the first Psychobuch. Media images pulled from fashion magazines, pulp literature, and LP covers are reworked painterly, digitally, or mechanically into a visual language built from recurring motifs. The softcover volume, 31 x 23 cm, was designed by Bischof with Samuel Bänziger.

Bischof began publishing laser-copied artist's magazines in 2005 to distribute his drawings, collages, and texts before adding sculpture, painting, and installation to his practice. He is represented by Bänziger Hug and Galerie Nicola von Senger in Switzerland. His other books include the original Psychobuch (Edition Patrick Frey, 2014) and Meta Cars (Nieves, 2025).
description.artist_bio: Beni Bischof is a Swiss multidisciplinary artist working across drawing, painting, sculpture, installation, collage, video, and sound. He began self-publishing laser-copied artist's magazines in 2005. He is represented by Bänziger Hug and Galerie Nicola von Senger.
